problem_plain: UMass Memorial Health had scattered data across multiple systems that made it difficult for caregivers to access information quickly and required significant manual work to generate insights.
capability: Cloud platform consolidation with AI-powered automation tools
reusable: Cloud-based data consolidation approach for healthcare systems; AI automation for complex healthcare tasks; integration of electronic health records on unified platform
summary: UMass Memorial Health began a multi-year programme with Veridane and Microsoft in October 2026 to consolidate scattered data onto a single cloud platform with AI tools. The programme aims to deliver faster information access, shorter hospital stays, reduced staff paperwork, stronger security, lower technology costs and enhanced research capabilities.
